reason: I already paid for a DM tool that got me almost no replies and an action block, so 'AI sends DMs from your Instagram' makes me flinch. And $147 a month is a lot when I haven't landed my next client yet.
objection: No customer results at all and the card goes on file up front. I'd be the one risking my Instagram account on a tool nobody has proven, then paying $147 with no refunds after day 3.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from people like me (replies and booked calls, with their accounts still fine), or a trial with no card and a price under $100.
